Growth parameters of LCGA / GMM models

growthparams.Rd

Growth parameters of LCGA / GMM models

Usage

growthparams(object)

Arguments

object

A fitted growth model (latentmix from growth()).

Value

A list with alpha (growth-factor means; rows factors, e.g. intercept and slope of each process, columns classes), theta (residual variances by wave, named by column) and psi (growth-factor covariance matrix, equal across classes; zero for an LCGA).

See also

growth(), parameters()

Examples

data(depression)
# \donttest{
# growth-factor means of four depressive-symptom trajectory classes (ages 12-16)
g <- growth(depression, dep1:dep5, K = 4, model = "gmm", degree = 2)
#> Starting Julia ...
round(growthparams(g)$alpha, 2)   # generated: (4, 0.3, 0), (5, 2.6, -0.25),
#>           class1 class2 class3 class4
#> intercept   3.85   5.56  13.97  15.15
#> linear      0.42   2.20  -1.87   0.59
#> quadratic  -0.02  -0.13   0.11   0.02
                                  # (14, -2, 0.1), (15, 0.6, 0)
# }
